annotation.title_clean: Kollaborierende Robotersysteme - Planung von Anlagen mit der Funktion „Leistungs- und Kraftbegrenzung“ (DGUV Information FB HM-080)
annotation.title_en: Collaborative Robot Systems – Planning of Installations with the Power and Force Limiting Function (DGUV Information FB HM-080)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Deutsche Gesetzliche Unfallversicherung (DGUV), Fachbereich Holz und Metall
annotation.summary_en: German statutory accident insurance (DGUV) guidance for planning collaborative industrial robot systems using power and force limiting. It explains Machinery Directive compliance, risk assessment, safety functions, biomechanical force and pressure limits and measurement, documentation, marking, and periodic inspections, complementing EN ISO 10218 and ISO/TS 15066.
key_provisions_or_claims: Collaborative robot systems fall under Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and need CE marking and a declaration of conformity.
Safety functions must meet EN ISO 13849-1 Category 3/PLd, including safe monitoring of force, speed and position.
Biomechanical limits for pressure and force by body region must be measured and not exceeded; head and neck contact is to be excluded.
Biomechanical limit values must be documented and delivered to the customer per ISO/TS 15066.
Under the Betriebssicherheitsverordnung, a hazard assessment and at least annual inspections are required, with re-measurement after modifications.
